name: cavalier_of_flame_discards_any_number_draws_that_many
notes: Printed: 'When this creature enters, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.' Any number is every number from zero to all of them (CR 107.1c): the controller discards Pitch Me, stops (NONE), keeps Keep Me, and draws one card, the number actually discarded. Before 2026-11-12 the engine discarded the whole hand with no ask and drew two (BACKLOG, verification wave 1): Keep Me ends in the graveyard and the pack fails. The mapper's repro was tools/scenarios/known_bugs/2026-11-05/discard_any_number_never_asked_and_dies_trigger_target/.
